target.statement: First-Act@1.0 for Gemini 3.1 Pro on the PaSBench-Video risk split (overall) is 20.0%

compute.basis: The target requires running a proprietary closed-source model (Gemini 3.1 Pro) via API over 481 videos with a sliding-window streaming protocol (~10 windows/video), which is impossible to reproduce locally without API access and would cost significant API fees; no code is released, only the dataset.

blockers: Target model (Gemini 3.1 Pro) is a proprietary closed-source API model, not runnable locally
No evaluation code released, only the dataset
Streaming protocol requires many API calls per video (3s windows, 0.3s stride), making API cost and time prohibitive
Reproducing the exact number requires the same model version and API behavior, which may change
title: PaSBench-Video: A Streaming Video Benchmark for Proactive Safety Warning
